chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Muhammad ibn Muslim and Zurarah, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام.
He was asked whether the fasting person may engage in مباشَرَة or kiss during the month of Ramadan.
So he said: Indeed, I fear for him, so let him refrain from that, unless he is confident that his semen will not precede him.

key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, in which fasting is observed
key_terms.فَلْيَتَنَزَّهْ: let him keep away or refrain out of caution
key_terms.مَنِيُّهُ: his semen, the emission of which is at issue in the ruling
key_terms.يُبَاشِرُ: to engage in intimate physical contact

ai.seo_question: Can a fasting person kiss or engage in intimacy during Ramadan without invalidating the fast?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning kissing or intimate contact for one who is fasting in Ramadan. Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام expresses caution, advising avoidance unless a person is sure that it will not lead to ejaculation and thereby jeopardize the fast.
